title: Boyfriend Material Workshop
location: 24 Nguyen Huu Huan, Hoan Kiem, Ha Noi
subtitle: Learn practical communication, care, and partnership skills for healthier relationships.
accessibility: Contact the host for access details
address: 24 Nguyen Huu Huan, Hoan Kiem, Ha Noi
about: Learn practical communication, care, and partnership skills for healthier relationships.
Listen actively and communicate needs clearly
Show care through dependable everyday actions
Handle disagreements with empathy and healthy boundaries
note: Please arrive 10 minutes early and check in at the ground-floor reception.
learn: Listen actively and communicate needs clearly
Show care through dependable everyday actions
Handle disagreements with empathy and healthy boundaries

plan.title: Understanding thoughtful partnership
plan.description: Explore what reliable care, respect, and emotional maturity look like in everyday relationships.

plan.title: Communication and active listening
plan.description: Practice listening without interrupting, expressing needs clearly, and responding with empathy.

plan.title: Care plans and healthy boundaries
plan.description: Turn workshop insights into realistic habits while respecting your own and your partner's boundaries.

faqs.question: Is this workshop only for people in relationships?
faqs.answer: No. Singles and couples are welcome. The skills apply to dating, committed relationships, and future partnerships.

faqs.question: Will I have to share private relationship details?
faqs.answer: No. You can participate using fictional examples and share only what feels comfortable.

faqs.question: Can couples attend together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Couples may attend together, and individual participants are equally welcome.

hostBio: I help beginners take stronger photos with the camera they already own. Lessons focus on composition, natural light, and a relaxed process for noticing memorable stories in everyday life.

beforeYouAttend.title: A respectful learning space
items: Come ready to participate in paired exercises
Keep personal stories shared by others private

cancellation: 24 hours before start. Full refund before deadline.
If the host cancels, guests can choose another session or receive a full refund.

title: Beginner Silver Ring-Making Workshop
location: 18 Hang Bac, Hoan Kiem, Ha Noi
subtitle: Craft a sterling silver ring by hand and finish it to a professional shine.
accessibility: Contact the host for access details
address: 18 Hang Bac, Hoan Kiem, Ha Noi
about: Craft a sterling silver ring by hand and finish it to a professional shine.
Learn the essential steps of sizing, shaping, soldering, filing, and polishing a wearable ring.
note: Please arrive 10 minutes early. Closed-toe shoes are recommended.

highlights.title: In person
highlights.description: Learn together in a working jewellery studio.

highlights.title: Beginner
highlights.description: No previous jewellery-making experience is needed.

learn: Measure and size a ring accurately
File, sand, and polish a professional finish
bring: A hair tie for long hair

plan.title: Design and sizing
plan.description: Choose a simple ring profile, measure your size, and prepare the silver.

plan.title: Shaping and soldering
plan.description: Form the silver around a mandrel and solder the joint with close guidance.

plan.title: Finishing and polishing
plan.description: File, sand, texture, and polish your ring before taking it home.

faqs.question: Do I need jewellery-making experience?
faqs.answer: No. The workshop is designed for beginners and every tool and technique is demonstrated.

faqs.question: Is the silver included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sterling silver for one finished ring is included in the workshop price.

hostBio: The Silver Studio teaches approachable jewellery-making techniques in a supportive working studio.

beforeYouAttend.title: Safety
items: Follow the host's tool and torch instructions.

cancellation: Cancel at least 24 hours before the session for a full refund.
